parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station Egwi (Etche LGA survey stations). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 295.88 | 0.54518 | 0.54518
2 | 798.6 | 3.5924 | 4.1376
3 | 864.62 | 2.1559 | 6.2935
4 | 1810.2 | 37.957 | 37.25
5 | 5634.2 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HAA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Egwi
Curve type: HAA-type
Aquifer depth: 6.29 – 37.25 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of approximately 35 to 40 m to tap the productive sandy aquifer within Layer 4 before encountering the resistive basement/substratum. Install well screens within the coarse sand intervals of this zone and conduct adequate gravel packing and well development for optimal yield.
